self_reported.application_info_text: THE FOUNDATION DOES NOT HAVE AN APPLICATION FORM. INSTEAD, A FULL PROPOSAL FOR FUNDING SHOULD BE SUBMITTED IN THE FORM OF A LETTER OF APPROXIMATELY 3 PAGES DESCRIBING THE ACTIVITY FOR WHICH FUNDS ARE BEING REQUESTED; IF APPLYING FOR THE FIRST TIME, GIVE A BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE ORGANIZATION'S MISSION, PURPOSE AND GOALS. IN ADDITION, INCLUDE A PROJECT BUDGET AND A COPY OF THE ORGANIZATION'S 501(C)(3) RULING FROM THE IRS. APPLICANTS FOR CURATORIAL RESEARCH FELLOWSHIPS MUST APPLY THROUGH THEIR INSTITUTIONS AND MUST INCLUDE A LETTER OF SUPPORT FROM THE INSTITUTION'S DIRECTOR. PROPOSALS MAY BE SUBMITTED BY MAIL OR EMAIL.
